$description: Household canonical design tokens — W3C DTCG 2025.10 format. Base OKLCH palette, then semantic --ds-* tokens for surface ladder, status intents, action/primary, radius, spacing, and typography. Style Dictionary v4 consumes this file and emits CSS custom properties, JavaScript constants, and a Tailwind v4 @theme block. Binding: no per-app overrides on named semantics — an app never invents a value for one. The two things an app chooses are its accent (--ds-color-primary and its pair) and a palette from tokens/palettes.json, which is a hue plus a chroma scale PROJECTED THROUGH the neutral ladder below. A palette declares no lightness, so the ladder's lightness steps — which carry every contrast guarantee this package makes — are unreachable from one. Reasoning: docs/development/decision-palette-catalogue-and-the-tone-axis.md.

palette.$description: Raw OKLCH scale — primitives only, not for direct use in components. Consume via semantic tokens below.

50.$description: warm ground light — the page the cards sit ON, so it is a light grey rather than near-white (design-system#17)

300.$description: border light — separates content, 1.5:1 floor against every surface it bounds (design-system#17)

400.$description: border-strong light — bounds a CONTROL, 3:1 floor per WCAG 1.4.11 (design-system#17)

500.$description: muted text light — 4.5:1 AA floor against every light surface (design-system#13); 0.600 -> 0.520 for #13, then 0.475 when #17 deepened the recessed rung

920.$description: card dark; surface-2 — lifted off the canvas so a card reads as elevated (design-system#17)

940.$description: elevated dark; surface-3 — popover/dialogue, a further step above the card

primary.$description: Action / brand. Concrete values are set per project by overriding --ds-color-primary in :root. These defaults use a neutral slate to force a deliberate brand choice.

status.$description: Five semantic status hues, each with light and dark values. Tuned so the base value reads as text in its mode against its ~14% tint surface.

semantic.$description: Semantic --ds-* tokens consumed directly by components and @theme blocks. Two groups: base (mode-independent) and colour (mode-sensitive, produced as :root + .dark blocks).

radius.$description: Corner radius scale — binding across all household apps. Base is 0.625rem.

spacing.$description: Named spacing scale for layout rhythm, consumed as --ds-spacing-* from hand-written CSS. Deliberately absent from the Tailwind @theme block: Tailwind resolves w-*/max-w-*/min-w-*/basis-* against --spacing-* ahead of --container-*, so registering these keys silently collapses the container scale. In Tailwind markup use the numeric scale instead — md is p-4.

text.$description: Supplementary type sizes that Tailwind's default scale lacks. 2xs is the uppercase eyebrow / column-head size — use text-2xs, never text-[11px].

2xs.$description: eyebrow / column head: uppercase, tracked, muted

font.$description: Three font families — binding. No per-app substitution.

display.$description: Display/headings — Fraunces variable (optical-size axis). Page titles, wordmarks, empty-state headings.

body.$value: 'Avenir Next', 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
body.$description: UI / body copy. Local-font-first: Avenir Next leads and renders on any machine where it is INSTALLED, which is not only Apple's — the operator has ported it to non-Apple household machines, so do not describe this token as macOS-only (corrected 23/08/2026, on his own statement). It is still never bundled or vendored here: it is not licensable for web embedding, which is a licensing limit on serving the file, not a limit on where it renders. Hanken Grotesk Variable (`@fontsource-variable/hanken-grotesk`) is the self-hosted fallback for machines without it — in practice the Android devices, where a font cannot be installed. Everything textual: labels, buttons, descriptions, table cells, nav.

code.$value: 'JetBrains Mono', 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace
code.$description: Monospaced data — JetBrains Mono. Machine-produced values only: IDs, hashes, ISO dates, amounts, counts, code.

font-size.$description: The root element's font-size override point. A consuming app sets the html element's font-size to var(--ds-font-size-base). Never registered as a Tailwind theme key — see THEME_EXCLUDED_NAMESPACES in sd.config.js.

base.$description: Ratified 31/07/2026. 100% equals the browser default (nominally 16px) while still scaling with a reader's own changed browser text-size preference — a fixed px value would silently override that preference instead.

colour.$description: Mode-sensitive semantic tokens. Each token has a light and dark sub-value; Style Dictionary emits them as :root (light) and .dark overrides.

light.$description: App ground. Carries the dot-grid in dark.
Sunken: nav rail, wells, table headers.
The ONE action accent — override per project in :root.
Alias of status-error; shadcn-svelte destructive variant.
Text on a solid destructive control; near-white in both modes.
